label: embedding-provider — FileSystemModelCache implementation
summary: Implemented FileSystemModelCache class in cache.ts per SPEC.md §1C (Model cache). Downloads ONNX model binaries from HuggingFace, verifies SHA-256 via sidecar .sha256 file, and provides ensure/cached/clear/ensureStream API matching the ModelCache interface.

changes.kind: added FileSystemModelCache class implementing ModelCache — 208 lines
added re-export of FileSystemModelCache from cache.js

handoff_notes: FileSystemModelCache is exported from index.ts for all package consumers
SHA-256 is computed on download and verified on every cached() call
The async ensure() and ensureStream() clean up partial downloads on error
The sync cached() method reads the full model binary into memory for hash verification — acceptable for the synchronous interface
